Definition: to be (causative) make well, literally (sound, beautiful) or figuratively (happy, successful, right)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be good, be pleasing, be well, be glad; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be glad, be joyful; 1a2) to be well placed; 1a3) to be well for, be well with, go well with; 1a4) to be pleasing, be pleasing to; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to make glad, rejoice; 1b2) to do good to, deal well with; 1b3) to do well, do thoroughly; 1b4) to make a thing good or right or beautiful; 1b5) to do well, do right
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
